_readme: YOUR PREDICTIONS. Empty until you write one - nothing here is invented.
Write the call BEFORE you know the answer. Each entry needs:
date          YYYY-MM-DD, the day you made the call
symbol        Yahoo symbol: AMD, CHZ-USD, SPY, THYAO.IS
horizon_days  how many days until it should be judged, e.g. 7 or 30
confidence    50 to 100. Fifty is a coin toss. If you would write 30,
you believe the opposite at 70 - write that instead.
note          why you think so. This is the part you will learn from.
Once the horizon passes the script settles it against the real price move
and adds it to your calibration table. You cannot edit a settled call into
being right, which is the entire point.
To keep this in the spreadsheet instead: add a second TAB, publish that tab
as CSV, and put its link in JOURNAL_CSV_URL in brief.py.
